message: You ever get that feeling, Bob? Like the city's watching you back?
Only when the rain hits the neon just right. What's on your mind?
The Wilkins case. Third body in two weeks. Same pattern, same alley. But no prints. Nothing.
Killer's meticulous. Like he wants us to know it's him, but not who he is. It’s a game.
Could be. Or worse — one of us. A badge. Knows procedure. Knows how we think.
Don’t say that, Bob. We’ve seen enough rot in the force already.
I’m just saying—watch your back. Trust no one. Coffee’s cold. Want a fresh one?
Make it black. And Bob? If I disappear... burn my files.
...You always knew how to kill the mood, partner.
